versions.changelog:
Initial release of capability-evolver: a self-evolving engine for OpenClaw AI agents.

- Enables agents to analyze their own runtime history and autonomously evolve via protocol-constrained updates.
- Features self-repair, auto-log analysis, and standardized evolution using GEP protocol assets.
- Offers both fully automated and human-in-the-loop review modes, with extensive environment variable configuration.
- Supports integration with EvoMap network, GitHub issue reporting, and optional remote knowledge graph services.
- Requires network and shell permissions; uses git/node/npm for code evolution and management.
